scenarios.title: A｜隔壁太吵
scenarios.setting: 在“噪音问题”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“隔壁太吵”。

turns.prompt: 关于「噪音问题」，你想说明遇到的问题或处理后的情况，会怎么说？

choices.text: Hi, the guests in the room next door are being very loud.

feedback.naturalExpression: Hi, the guests in the room next door are being very loud.
feedback.explanation: “being very loud”描述眼下很吵的行为，而不是把人一概评价为吵闹。

choices.text: There’s a lot of noise coming from the room next door.

feedback.naturalExpression: There’s a lot of noise coming from the room next door.
feedback.explanation: 用“there be”说明存在的事物或情况，先呈现事实，便于对方继续处理。

choices.text: The people next door have been making a lot of noise.

feedback.naturalExpression: The people next door have been making a lot of noise.
feedback.explanation: “have been”把过去开始的状态与现在联系起来，常用于说明持续情况或经历。

choices.text: I can hear loud music from the room next door.

feedback.naturalExpression: I can hear loud music from the room next door.
feedback.explanation: 说明可以提供的行动或可行方案，让对话有明确的下一步。

choices.text: My next room is too noisy.

feedback.naturalExpression: Hi, the guests in the room next door are being very loud.
feedback.explanation: 隔壁房间用“the room next door”，而“my next room”可能指自己下一间房。

turns.text: I’m sorry about that. How long has it been going on?

turns.prompt: 你想说明日期、时长或时间上的需求，会怎么说？

choices.text: For about an hour.

feedback.naturalExpression: For about an hour.
feedback.explanation: 用时间短语标明时点或持续时长，让对方能据此安排，而不只知道一个模糊的“晚点”。

choices.text: It’s been going on since around midnight.

feedback.naturalExpression: It’s been going on since around midnight.
feedback.explanation: 用时间短语标明时点或持续时长，让对方能据此安排，而不只知道一个模糊的“晚点”。

choices.text: Quite a while. I’m having trouble sleeping.

feedback.naturalExpression: Quite a while. I’m having trouble sleeping.
feedback.explanation: 说明正在尝试的动作或遇到的困难，帮助对方针对卡住的环节提供协助。

turns.text: We’ll contact the guests and ask them to keep the noise down.

turns.prompt: 你想回应对方的帮助或安排，表达谢意，会怎么说？

choices.text: Thank you. I’d really appreciate that.

feedback.naturalExpression: Thank you. I’d really appreciate that.
feedback.explanation: 用简短感谢接住对方的帮助或答复，表示已经收到这份好意。

choices.text: Great. Hopefully that helps. Thank you.

feedback.naturalExpression: Great. Hopefully that helps. Thank you.
feedback.explanation: “hopefully”表达希望事情朝某个方向发展，不等于保证结果。

choices.text: Thanks. Please let them know it’s quite late.

feedback.naturalExpression: Thanks. Please let them know it’s quite late.
feedback.explanation: 用简短感谢接住对方的帮助或答复，表示已经收到这份好意。

scenarios.title: B｜走廊太吵
scenarios.setting: 在“噪音问题”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“走廊太吵”。

turns.prompt: 关于「噪音问题」，你想说明遇到的问题或处理后的情况，会怎么说？

choices.text: Hi, there’s a lot of noise in the hallway outside my room.

feedback.naturalExpression: Hi, there’s a lot of noise in the hallway outside my room.
feedback.explanation: 用“there be”说明存在的事物或情况，先呈现事实，便于对方继续处理。

choices.text: People have been talking loudly in the hallway.

feedback.naturalExpression: People have been talking loudly in the hallway.
feedback.explanation: “have been”把过去开始的状态与现在联系起来，常用于说明持续情况或经历。

choices.text: There’s been a lot of noise outside my door.

feedback.naturalExpression: There’s been a lot of noise outside my door.
feedback.explanation: 用“there be”说明存在的事物或情况，先呈现事实，便于对方继续处理。

choices.text: It’s very noisy in the hallway tonight.

feedback.naturalExpression: It’s very noisy in the hallway tonight.
feedback.explanation: 接着上文说明对象的具体情况，指代清楚时无需重复完整名称。

choices.text: Outside my room is too noisy.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Hi, there’s a lot of noise in the hallway outside my room.
feedback.explanation: 意思清楚，但范围较宽；如果声音来自走廊，点明“the hallway outside my room”更便于处理。

turns.text: I’m sorry. We’ll have someone check the floor.

turns.prompt: 你想回应对方的帮助或安排，表达谢意，会怎么说？

choices.text: Thank you. It’s been going on for quite a while.

feedback.naturalExpression: Thank you. It’s been going on for quite a while.
feedback.explanation: 用简短感谢接住对方的帮助或答复，表示已经收到这份好意。

choices.text: I’d appreciate that. I’m trying to sleep.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’d appreciate that. I’m trying to sleep.
feedback.explanation: “I’d appreciate”将希望对方做的事与感谢联系起来，语气比直接命令更委婉。

choices.text: Could someone check it soon, please?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could someone check it soon, please?
feedback.explanation: 把需要的行动明确说出来，并用礼貌用语缓和请求；对方能直接回应能否做到。

turns.text: Of course. We’ll take care of it.

scenarios.title: C｜外面施工
scenarios.setting: 在“噪音问题”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“外面施工”。

turns.prompt: 关于「噪音问题」，你想说明遇到的问题或处理后的情况，会怎么说？

choices.text: Hi, there’s a lot of construction noise outside my room.

feedback.naturalExpression: Hi, there’s a lot of construction noise outside my room.
feedback.explanation: 用“there be”说明存在的事物或情况，先呈现事实，便于对方继续处理。

choices.text: There’s construction going on outside, and it’s very loud.

feedback.naturalExpression: There’s construction going on outside, and it’s very loud.
feedback.explanation: 用“there be”说明存在的事物或情况，先呈现事实，便于对方继续处理。

choices.text: The construction noise woke me up this morning.

feedback.naturalExpression: The construction noise woke me up this morning.
feedback.explanation: “woke me up”说明声音把自己吵醒，指出噪音产生的实际影响。

choices.text: I wasn’t told there would be construction outside the hotel.

feedback.naturalExpression: I wasn’t told there would be construction outside the hotel.
feedback.explanation: “wasn’t told”说明事前没有收到告知，适合解释为什么实际情况与预期不符。

choices.text: Outside is building something and very noisy.

feedback.naturalExpression: Hi, there’s a lot of construction noise outside my room.
feedback.explanation: “outside”不能在这里作正在施工的人；可说“There’s construction outside”，再说明噪音影响。

turns.text: I’m sorry about the disturbance. The construction is taking place across the street.

turns.prompt: 你想进一步确认时间，会怎么问？

choices.text: How long will the construction continue today?

feedback.naturalExpression: How long will the construction continue today?
feedback.explanation: “How long”询问持续时长，而不是具体几点。

choices.text: Do you know what time they’ll stop working?

feedback.naturalExpression: Do you know what time they’ll stop working?
feedback.explanation: “What time”请对方给出具体时点，适合确认开始、结束或赴约时间。

choices.text: Will it be this noisy every morning?

feedback.naturalExpression: Will it be this noisy every morning?
feedback.explanation: “every morning”表示每天重复发生，区别于只发生一次的情况。

choices.text: How many days will the construction last?

feedback.naturalExpression: How many days will the construction last?
feedback.explanation: “How many”询问可数事物的数量，后面通常接复数名词。

turns.text: They’re scheduled to work until 5 p.m., and construction will continue throughout the week.

turns.prompt: 你想询问能否换一个更合适的位置或房间，会怎么说？

choices.text: Do you have a quieter room on the other side of the hotel?

feedback.naturalExpression: Do you have a quieter room on the other side of the hotel?
feedback.explanation: 先确认有没有所需的物品、服务或安排，为后面的选择提供依据。

choices.text: Would it be possible to move to a room away from the construction?

feedback.naturalExpression: Would it be possible to move to a room away from the construction?
feedback.explanation: “away from”表示远离，可用于说明想避开的噪音源或希望的位置。

choices.text: Is there anything you can do about the noise?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is there anything you can do about the noise?
feedback.explanation: 先确认有没有所需的物品、服务或安排，为后面的选择提供依据。

scenarios.title: D｜要求酒店处理或换房
scenarios.setting: 在“噪音问题”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“要求酒店处理或换房”。

turns.text: We’ve contacted the guests / checked the hallway, but I’m sorry to hear that the noise is still bothering you.

turns.prompt: 关于「噪音问题」，你想说明遇到的问题或处理后的情况，会怎么说？

choices.text: Unfortunately, it’s still very loud.

feedback.naturalExpression: Unfortunately, it’s still very loud.
feedback.explanation: “still”强调原来的状态目前没有改变，是跟进进度或确认安排时的关键信息。

choices.text: I’m still having trouble sleeping because of the noise.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m still having trouble sleeping because of the noise.
feedback.explanation: 说明正在尝试的动作或遇到的困难，帮助对方针对卡住的环节提供协助。

choices.text: The noise hasn’t stopped. Is there anything else you can do?

feedback.naturalExpression: The noise hasn’t stopped. Is there anything else you can do?
feedback.explanation: 主动询问还有哪些选择，原方案行不通时仍能继续商量。

choices.text: It’s still same noisy.

feedback.naturalExpression: Unfortunately, it’s still very loud.
feedback.explanation: 表示和之前一样吵可说“just as noisy”；“same noisy”不能这样组合。

turns.text: I’m sorry. We can speak to them again, or we can see if another room is available.

turns.prompt: 你想询问能否换一个更合适的位置或房间，会怎么说？

choices.text: Could you check if there’s a quieter room available?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you check if there’s a quieter room available?
feedback.explanation: “available”指可获得或可使用的；询问服务时常指有没有余位。

choices.text: I’d prefer to change rooms, if possible.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’d prefer to change rooms, if possible.
feedback.explanation: 把选择说成自己的偏好，可以表明立场，而不必否定另一种选择。

choices.text: Could you move me to a room farther away from the noise?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you move me to a room farther away from the noise?
feedback.explanation: “away from”表示远离，可用于说明想避开的噪音源或希望的位置。

choices.text: I’d like you to deal with the noise first, please.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’d like you to deal with the noise first, please.
feedback.explanation: “deal with the noise first”说明优先希望处理噪音，而不是立刻换房。

turns.text: We have a quiet room available on the other side of the hotel.

turns.prompt: 你想确认更安静的替代房间在房型或费用上有何变化，会怎么说？

choices.text: Is it the same room type as my current room?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is it the same room type as my current room?
feedback.explanation: “room type”指房型，换房时可据此确认规格是否保持一致。

choices.text: Would there be any additional charge?

feedback.naturalExpression: Would there be any additional charge?
feedback.explanation: 先确认后续安排能否实现，便于对方说明条件、时间或限制。

choices.text: How far is it from my current room?

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Is it the same room type as my current room?
feedback.explanation: 这句自然，但问的是距离；如果此时关心换房条件，应另核对房型或额外费用。

choices.text: Is it away from the construction / noisy room?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is it away from the construction / noisy room?
feedback.explanation: “away from”表示远离，可用于说明想避开的噪音源或希望的位置。

turns.text: It’s the same room type, and there won’t be any extra charge.

turns.prompt: 关于「噪音问题」，你想让对方了解你的需求或来意，会怎么说明？

choices.text: In that case, I’d like to change rooms.

feedback.naturalExpression: In that case, I’d like to change rooms.
feedback.explanation: “in that case”表示根据刚得知的情况调整方案，让前后决定衔接起来。

choices.text: That sounds good. I’ll take it.

feedback.naturalExpression: That sounds good. I’ll take it.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

choices.text: Great. Could you prepare a new key card for me?

feedback.naturalExpression: Great. Could you prepare a new key card for me?
feedback.explanation: “key card”指房卡，即开门用的卡片。

turns.text: Certainly. You can pick up your new key card at the front desk.

turns.prompt: 关于「噪音问题」，你想说明自己接下来能做什么或打算怎么做，会怎么说？

choices.text: Great. I’ll come down now. Thank you.

feedback.naturalExpression: Great. I’ll come down now. Thank you.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

choices.text: Perfect. Thanks for helping me sort this out.

feedback.naturalExpression: Perfect. Thanks for helping me sort this out.
feedback.explanation: 感谢后面说明具体原因，让对方知道哪项帮助对自己有用。

choices.text: Thank you. I really appreciate it.

feedback.naturalExpression: Thank you. I really appreciate it.
feedback.explanation: “appreciate it”是简短感谢，“it”指对方刚提供的帮助。
